descriptor: Utility site for CSS box shadows

voice.summary: Depth Bench talks like a workshop bench for front-end developers: tools first, jargon welcome and nothing flashy. Labels are exact and every control shows its CSS.
dos: Name each control with its CSS property
Show the copy-ready CSS at all times
Explain presets in a single phrase
donts: Do not call a shadow beautiful or stunning

boilerplate: Depth Bench is a utility site for designers and developers featuring a layered box-shadow editor, a natural shadow generator and copy-ready CSS for any surface.

microcopy.error: Could not copy. Select the CSS by hand.
microcopy.empty: No layers yet. Add a layer.

logo.note: Stacked layers represent the layered shadows the tool builds.
